results.text: HB-100 owner could not add a new door sensor; app showed E-201. Base station already had 8 devices. Customer removed an old test sensor and pairing succeeded. Resolved at frontline.

Put the base station into pairing mode from the app (Add Device). Then hold the SYNC button on the camera or sensor for 3 seconds until its LED blinks blue. Keep the peripheral within 1 metre of the base station during pairing. Pairing times out after 120 seconds. After pairing, the device can be moved to its final location.

The base station could not write the new binding into its binding table. A single occurrence can follow a power interruption during pairing; retry once after restarting the base station. If E-207 repeats, or the app lists a device that the base station table does not contain, the binding table is likely corrupted: escalate to FAE. Do not factory-reset the base station.
